notes: Official www.nyu.edu university AI pages were inaccessible (bot challenge), so the university layer here is the NYU Libraries guide only. No computing-unit policy found. Steinhardt is a non-computing school; its page is guidance with sample statements, so many units are sample or template language addressed to instructors. Reconciliation: both coders agreed the Steinhardt page is school-level guidance with sample statements and the Libraries guide is the only university-layer document; the two documents were reconciled unit by unit. Coder B merged several sample statements into one unit (for example permission plus the student-own-work requirement); these were split back into separate units so that each unit holds one rule.

documents.summary: A Steinhardt AI Hub page that advises faculty to write explicit AI statements and offers sample syllabus language for permitted use, prohibited use, attribution, group work and art or music reflections. It also covers student-data privacy under FERPA, assessment design, citation formats for AI, and a notice that detectors are unreliable. It is school-level and not specific to computing.
